appName.description: Extension name, shown in the browser and the store.

appDescription.message: Bewertet Amazon-Lebensmittel 0–100 nach Zutaten, Zusatzstoffen und Verarbeitung. Lokal auf Ihrem Computer.
appDescription.description: Store description. Must stay under 132 characters in every locale.

headDisqualifying.description: Panel section: ingredients that cap the score.

reportNoUrl.message: Set a contribution URL in settings

srcBarcode.message: Matched by barcode via Open Food Facts — not from this page

disclaimer.message: Ein Leitfaden zu dem, was auf dem Etikett steht — keine Gesundheitsberatung. Zutaten können unvollständig oder veraltet sein — prüfen Sie die Verpackung.

allergenCaveat.message: Found in the ingredient text on this page. Absence of a warning is not a safety check — never rely on this for an allergy.

failTitle.message: Zutaten auf dieser Seite konnten nicht gelesen werden.

failUnreadable.message: The ingredients are published, but almost none of them match anything this tool knows — usually that means the label is in a language it cannot read yet. Scoring it anyway would produce a confident wrong answer.

failLookup.message: The optional barcode lookup didn't return an ingredient list.

failNoText.message: Amazon doesn't always publish them as text — sometimes they only exist inside the label photo.

failPastePrompt.message: Paste them here and I'll score it.

pasteInvalid.message: That doesn't look like an ingredient list yet.

loadingBody.message: Amazon didn't publish readable ingredients, so the optional barcode fallback is looking for this product. No Amazon page or browsing data is sent.

notFoodTitle.message: Nicht bewertet — sieht nicht nach Lebensmittel aus.

notFoodBody.message: A score here would treat it as something you eat.

notFoodWhy.message: This is on because “Only rate food & supplements” is enabled in settings.

notFoodNothing.message: Nothing disclosed about how this was produced

popupShowRatingsD.message: Der Hauptschalter. Aus stoppt alles auf Amazon-Seiten — kein Panel, keine Badges, kein Beobachten. Nichts darunter wird vergessen.

popupBadgesD.message: Score chips on tiles you've already opened.

popupDisclaimer.message: Scores are a guide, not health or allergy advice. Always read the label.

popupFoodOnlyD.message: Skip shoes, toys, cosmetics and cleaning products, and say why instead of scoring them. Shampoo has an ingredient list too, and a score on one implies it was judged as something you could eat.

popupAutoScoreD.message: Scores results automatically as you scroll. For each one this computer and the shared database cannot already answer, it requests the product page from the Amazon store you are on, a few at a time and at most 60 per results page, with your Amazon sign-in. Amazon sees these requests much as if you had opened the products yourself. Off: only products already read get a score.

popupHoverD.message: Hover or tab to a search result for half a second and it requests that product page from Amazon to score it, with your Amazon sign-in. Only the result you point at.

popupOffD.message: When a page has a barcode but no readable ingredients, look it up. Sends the barcode to Open Food Facts and nothing else — no page content, no browsing history.

popupTagline.message: Zutatenqualität, Zusatzstoffe und Verarbeitung — lokal bewertet.

srcOcr.message: Read from the label photo on this page

loadingOcrBody.message: Amazon didn't publish the ingredients as text, so the label image is being read on your computer. This takes a few seconds and nothing is sent anywhere.

loadingOcrSlowBody.message: Large photos take longer. This stays on your computer — nothing is sent anywhere.

failOcr.message: The label photo was checked too, and no ingredient list could be read from it.

failLocale.message: This Amazon store’s labels are in a script the on-device English reader will misread, so photo OCR is not used here yet. Paste the list if you can read it.

throttleBody.message: Too many product-page requests were blocked. Auto-score is paused on this search so we do not keep retrying. Cached badges still show. Open a product, or start a new search, to try again.

popupOcrD.message: When a page has no readable ingredients, read them from the product's label photo. Runs on your computer and takes a few seconds per product — nothing is sent anywhere.

popupKept.message: Paused. Everything below is kept and comes back when you switch it on.

coverageWarn.message: Only $PCT$% of this list was recognised — treat the score as a partial reading.

producedSilent.message: No certification, feed, or origin claim on the page. Commodity $KIND$ with a silent label is conventionally raised by default.

popupNoScore.message: Not scored yet. Wait for the panel on this page, then reopen.

popupSearchPage.message: Search page — scores show as badges on tiles you have already opened.

popupOffDenied.message: Chrome did not grant Open Food Facts access.

popupOffNotKept.message: Chrome did not keep the Open Food Facts permission.

popupCompareEmpty.message: Bewerten Sie zwei Produkte auf Amazon, dann wählen Sie sie hier. Nur Cache — keine Extra-Anfragen.

optLede.message: Die Bewertung läuft auf deinem Computer. Die gemeinsame Datenbank und die Einstellungs-Sicherung lassen sich unten abschalten.

optScoreIsH.message: What a score is, and is not

optShare.message: Gefundene Zertifizierungen an die gemeinsame Datenbank senden

optSendDiag.message: Bewertungsdiagnosen an die gemeinsame Datenbank senden

optNotExport.message: That file is not an Ingredient Check settings export

optImportFailed.message: That file could not be read

optResetConfirm.message: Gewichtungen, Warnungen und Vermeiden-Liste auf Standard zurücksetzen? Online-Sicherungen bleiben erhalten.

badgeNoIngredients.message: Amazon doesn't publish readable ingredients for this one

catHelp_grain.message: Default 1.0: gluten grains are a penalty, including whole wheat. Enriched and white flour cost more; wheat, barley and rye still count when they are whole grain, because this dial is gluten as much as refinement. Traditionally prepared grains (sourdough, sprouted, soaked) count half. Lower this weight if you do not want gluten grains counted against a score. NOVA still treats plain flour as processed (3) and enriched as ultra (4) — that mapping is not this dial.

optNoteRateSame.message: These settings are the same ones in the toolbar popup. Changing them here updates scores on Amazon immediately.

optNoteFoodOnly.message: Skips shoes, toys, cosmetics, medicine and cleaning products. A score on shampoo would imply it was judged as something you could eat. When this is on, a non-food page shows why it was skipped instead of a silent blank.

optNoteWeights.message: 1.0 is the default weight. 0 switches a category off entirely. 2.0 makes it matter twice as much. Categories set to 0 by default are ones people reasonably disagree about — turn them on if you want them. Press / to jump to the filter.

optNoteAllergen.message: Flagged on the panel. These never change the score — whether a food contains sesame is a different question from whether it is a good food.

optNoteAvoid.message: One ingredient or phrase per line. Anything matching gets flagged on the panel.

optNoteExport.message: Exports as a plain JSON file you can keep, edit, or move to another computer.

loadingCacheBody.message: Amazon hat die Zutaten nicht als Text veröffentlicht. Es wird geprüft, ob dieses Produkt schon gelesen wurde – hier oder in der gemeinsamen Datenbank.

popupBreakdownD.message: Fahre mit der Maus über eine Bewertung in den Suchergebnissen, springe mit Tab dorthin oder klicke sie an, um zu sehen, was sie erhöht und gesenkt hat. Wird auf deinem Computer aus bereits Gelesenem berechnet — keine zusätzlichen Anfragen.

optNoteBreakdown.message: Fahre mit der Maus über eine Bewertung in den Suchergebnissen, springe mit Tab dorthin oder klicke sie an, um zu sehen, was sie erhöht und gesenkt hat. Wird auf deinem Computer aus bereits Gelesenem mit deinen aktuellen Gewichtungen berechnet — keine zusätzlichen Anfragen. Ein Klick hält sie offen; Esc oder ein Klick daneben schließt sie.

breakdownNone.message: Diese Bewertung wurde gespeichert, bevor Begründungen aufbewahrt wurden. Öffne das Produkt, um zu sehen, warum.

breakdownClean.message: Nichts auf diesem Etikett hat die Bewertung erhöht oder gesenkt.

breakdownTrimmed.message: Es werden nur die wichtigsten Gründe gezeigt.

breakdownDiffers.message: Die Produktseite hat dies mit $SCORE$ bewertet, mit geteilten Zertifizierungsdaten, die diese Aufschlüsselung nicht enthält.

popupAutoScoreNet.message: Requests product pages from Amazon, signed in as you.

popupHoverNet.message: Requests that product page from Amazon, signed in as you.

popupNetworkLink.message: Amazon access and what is sent

optNoteAutoScore.message: On by default. As you scroll a results page, each result that this computer and the shared database cannot already answer is scored by requesting its product page from the Amazon store you are on: three at a time, at most 60 per results page. The requests carry your Amazon sign-in, so Amazon sees them much as if you had opened each product yourself. Turn this off and only products already read (by you, or through the shared database) show a score.

optNoteHover.message: Off by default. Hover or tab to one result for half a second and it requests that product page from Amazon in the same way, with your Amazon sign-in. Only the result you point at.

autoNoticeTitle.message: Ingredient Check is rating these results

autoNoticeBody.message: To score a result, it requests that product's page from this Amazon store in the background, signed in as you: a few at a time, at most 60 per results page. Amazon sees each request much as if you had opened the product. You can change this at any time in the Ingredient Check toolbar popup.

popupGoalsCombined.message: Ziele kombiniert: Wo zwei denselben Regler setzen, wird gemittelt.

optNotePresets.message: Wähle ein Ziel oder mehrere — sie werden kombiniert, und wo zwei denselben Regler setzen, wird gemittelt. Manche Ziele machen aus einem Minus ein Plus: fettreduzierte Milchprodukte bei Abnehmen, zugesetzte Vitamine bei Vitamine & Mineralstoffe. Harte Obergrenzen wie Red 40 werden nie zum Plus. Du kannst danach jeden Regler verschieben; dann steht dort Benutzerdefiniert. Ein erneuter Klick entfernt ein Ziel; Ausgewogen setzt alle zurück.

welGoalsLede.message: Wähle alle, die passen — sie werden kombiniert. Die Bewertungen passen sich an: Bei Abnehmen werden fettarme Milchprodukte zum Plus, bei Vitamine & Mineralstoffe zugesetzte Vitamine. Nichts wählen heißt ausgewogener Standard.

welWarnLede.message: Tippe Allergene oder Ernährungsweisen an. Warnungen stehen über der Bewertung und ändern sie nie. Sie beziehen sich nur auf den Zutatentext der Seite — prüfe immer die Verpackung.

welAvoidLede.message: Optional. Produkte, die das enthalten, bekommen eine rote Markierung. Tippe gängige an oder schreibe eigene, eine pro Zeile.

welOptionsLede.message: Bewertet wird immer auf deinem Computer. Hier legst du fest, was die Erweiterung abrufen darf. Du kannst das später im Symbolleisten-Popup ändern.

welSharedD.message: Nutzt, was andere bereits von einem Produkt gelesen haben, damit es nicht erneut von Amazon geladen wird. Sendet nie deine Einstellungen oder etwas über dich.

welDoneLede.message: Öffne ein Lebensmittel oder eine Suche bei Amazon. Fahre über eine Bewertung in den Ergebnissen, um die Begründung zu sehen. Alles hier lässt sich später in den Einstellungen ändern.

optStoresLede.message: Where Ingredient Check works today, and which stores are planned. A planned store is not available yet: the extension does not run there and reads nothing from it.

optRequestLede.message: Tell us which online grocery store you want next. This makes a draft in your own email app, addressed to jackson29382938@gmail.com. Nothing is sent until you press Send there, and it goes from your email address, so the recipient will see it.

optRequestUrlNote.message: Only the website's address is kept. Anything after it, such as a product or a search, is removed before the draft is made.

optRequestPreviewH.message: The draft will contain exactly this:

optRequestPreviewEmpty.message: Enter a store name to see the draft.

failNoTextStore.message: $STORE$ doesn't publish an ingredient list for every product.

labelClosedTitle.message: Open “Label info” to score this product.

labelClosedBody.message: This store only shows the ingredient list once that section is open. Ingredient Check reads it from this page on your computer; nothing is sent anywhere.

optStorePreview.message: Preview — works on the pages you open; still being checked

optNoteTarget.message: Target (preview): Ingredient Check also runs on Target product and search pages. There it only reads the page you have open and scores it on your computer. It requests nothing from Target or anyone else, and a Target search page shows scores only for products you opened before. The two options above apply to Amazon only.
